reproduction: python scripts/diagnose_phenomt_initial_rates.py --case single_spin high_mass_ratio --sample-rate 2048 16384 --backend torch jax --phase 0.0 0.7 --odd-rate-sweep --output receipt.json

conventions.derivative: Initial time derivative of the returned unit axis; 9-point one-sided polynomial stencil, with a 5-point stencil sensitivity check.
conventions.spin_parity: Even=(rate(+S1)+rate(-S1))/2; odd=(rate(+S1)-rate(-S1))/2; S2=0, fixed masses/f_ref/source triad. Each J-frame is rotated back using its own initial beta and spin azimuth; initial Lhat=(0,0,1) and the complete Rz(alpha0)Ry(beta0)Rz(gamma0) reference triad are checked.
conventions.physics: Sturani T1500554v23 Eq.21: native even rate is (3/2)*kappa1*(1/x1-1)*v^6*(Lhat.S1)*(Lhat cross S1)/(L_NS*M_seconds), where S1=x1^2*chi1, L_NS is the nonspin 3PN angular momentum and kappa1=1. The v8 term is excluded as in production PV300.
conventions.scope: Binary diagnostic only. Near-zero spin-even behavior does not uniquely identify the reference equations, internal quadrupole parameter, or denominator. Finite differences, reference-frequency anchoring, spin-dependent denominators and axis definitions can affect rates. No production equations are changed.
conventions.positive_control: SpinTaylorT4 public binary with explicit quadparam1/2=0 or 1, spinO=5, tideO=0, phaseO=7, lscorr=0, lambda1/2=0. Spin vectors are chi_i=S_i/m_i^2. This directly measures spin parity without Euler-frame reconstruction; only its initial spin-even rate is compared with native PV300, not its full dynamics.
conventions.odd_rate_sweep: Opt-in sweep uses fixed sample rate 16384 Hz, phase 0, and zero companion spin. Rates and stencil uncertainties are in 1/s. It records signed carrier-frequency anchoring metrics from binary_rate and compares the selected native frontends' odd rates with the independent full v5+v7+v9 over L3PN formula; no residual fitting is performed. The SO numerator follows Sturani Eqs. (3), (22), and (25), with nonspin L from Eq. (5) and the PhenomTP Eq. (13) constraint. Amplitude residuals compare full/(2*half)-1 for each mass/frequency pair.
